mood: Oblique landscape: a silver octagonal heart-window shell lies on pale stone, far from a small detached hinge-rim fragment. Navy glass holds a partial face, turquoise hair arc and pale hands around a fissured pink-lavender heart with silver branches. Angular nested rims, bright bevels, dark seams and fasteners remain.
material_language: Satin silver casing with nested polished bevels, dark joints and recessed circular fasteners
Glossy navy-blue portrait field with turquoise hair and smooth pale hands
Mottled pink-lavender heart with dark fissures and branching silver ornament
Chalk-white to pale gray stone with restrained fine veining
lighting: Soft oblique light catches silver bevels and casts separate contact shadows; luminous blue interior contrasts with the pale stone exterior.
object_inventory: Silver octagonal shell enclosing a blue-lit heart aperture and pale hands
negative_constraints: No joined or stacked open clamshell, complete second shell, pedestal tableau or near-identical source arrangement.
No lower control panel, keypad, display, readable wording, logos or recognizable portrait identity.
No stretching, forced cropping, padding or pasted source photograph to convert the portrait reference into landscape.
No complete frontal portrait with twin ponytails and the original full hand arrangement.
No unrelated landscape, room, skyline, macro texture or palette-only substitution for the sculptural source.
No labels, cards, pins, target rings, crosshairs, debug marks or additional source-window features.
